europe_now.title: NATO Commander Issues Sabotage Warning
europe_now.summary: NATO's top military commander has issued a warning to Russia regarding alleged sabotage operations. The official emphasized that any potential attacks would face a robust response from the alliance.

sources.headline: REPLAY: NATO's top military commander warns Russia over alleged sabotage

europe_now.title: Assassination Plot Foiled Against Polish Prime Minister
europe_now.summary: Polish police successfully foiled an alleged assassination attempt targeting the country's prime minister. Authorities have launched subsequent inquiries into security breaches and intelligence access related to the incident.

sources.headline: Poland: Police foils alleged assassination attempt against PM

top_stories.title: Energy Truce Reactions
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian leadership responded to a newly announced energy ceasefire by stating they learned of the initiative through media reports. Meanwhile, European officials expressed skepticism and criticism regarding proposed policy adjustments concerning Russian imports.

sources.headline: ‘This deal doesn’t help’: Europe slams Trump’s plan to buy Russian diesel

top_stories.title: School Shooting in France
top_stories.summary: A 14-year-old pupil was arrested following a shooting incident at a French school that left two teaching staff wounded. Police detained the suspect after the attack involving hunting rifle fire.
